paper.title: Chemistry in Externally FUV-irradiated Disks in the Outskirts of the Orion Nebula

notes: One of the largest silhouette/edge-on disks in the Orion Nebula, ~10 arcmin N of the Trapezium (outside the Ricci 2008 ACS Treasury field). HST 3-color shows a bipolar reflection nebula bisected by the edge-on disk lane (Smith et al. 2005); ALMA Band 6 resolves an inclined dust ring with a central cavity (Díaz-Berríos et al. 2024). Distance = ONC (~414 pc). Added 2026-07-11.
